decisions.statement: The first beat runs at once before the timer is ever set.
A beat falls every thirty seconds.
A null agent id skips the record.
The polls still run where the agent id is null.
A poll that throws is logged by name.
The other polls still run where one poll throws.
A record that throws is logged and the beat is otherwise unchanged.
The registration account is null where no account is given.
A beat returns before its work is done.
A slow poll is never cancelled.
Two beats can be in flight at once.
Nothing here ever clears the timer this module returns.

definition: the beat on which a supervisor records itself and runs its polls
